title: Whole-job handoff contract
goal: Define capability-first signed handoff after reviewing the F-045 remote capability prerequisite; no runtime delegation is authorized by this contract task
acceptance: Distinguish bounded worker actions from delegated whole sorties
Inspect F-045 remote capability prerequisite before implementing delegation
Unknown outcomes remain held until reconciled
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures; do not send private inputs to another inference host or enable services/devices without existing authorization.
validation: Run affected regressions across the changed boundary and applicable fast checks
Keep human/device acceptance and independent review distinct from fixture results
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects
Escalate repeated tool failures or inadequate context; no automatic cloud fallback

effort.basis: Estimate added at featurePlans adoption (2026-11-11): Whole-job handoff contract and regressions. Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 3 hours agent; former 2-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge: median 0.56 h, p75 2.1 h, p90 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement) put a focused day at about 1.5 agent hours, with 0.75 h the least for one PR with review and CI. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 2 kept as history.
